name: Implement and Verify
description: Engineer-side process for the improvement loop. Implements changes within scope globs, runs pre-commit gates, provisions a test agent for live verification, exercises canned test missions, opens a PR, and tears down the test agent. Designed to be invoked via delegation from a product-architect agent.

scope_globs.description: File patterns the implementation may touch (e.g., 'corekit/lib/scheduler.mjs')

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable criteria from the architect's proposal

proposal_link.description: Drive link to the architect's proposal document

branch_slug.description: Short slug for the branch name (e.g., 'dedup-scheduler')

steps.title: Clone repo and implement changes
steps.accept_criteria: Changes implemented within scope globs. Feature branch created. All changes committed with clear messages. No files outside scope were modified.

steps.title: Run pre-commit gates
steps.description:
Run all pre-commit checks to verify the implementation:
1. JSON parse: validate all .json files touched
2. Run `validate-contracts` if contracts.json was changed
3. Run `node --test test/*.test.mjs` — all tests must pass
4. Check manifest integrity if manifests were changed
5. Verify `git diff --staged` shows only in-scope changes
6. Check for debug artifacts: no console.log, debugger, or TODO added

If any gate fails, fix the issue and re-run. Do not proceed with failures.

Output: gate results (pass/fail for each check), test output summary.
steps.accept_criteria: All pre-commit gates pass: tests pass, no out-of-scope changes, no debug artifacts. Gate results documented.

steps.title: Provision and verify test agent
steps.description:
Provision a test agent to validate the changes on a live VM:
1. Push the feature branch to remote: `git push origin refactor/IMP-${branch_slug}`
2. Hire a test agent: `fleet-hire test-imp --job swe`
3. Wait for the agent to come online: `fleet-status test-imp`
4. Upgrade the test agent to the feature branch: `fleet-upgrade test-imp --ref refactor/IMP-${branch_slug}`
5. Verify the agent is healthy: `fleet-verify test-imp` — repeat until green (max 5 attempts, 60s between)

If fleet-hire fails, check SA/IAM prerequisites and retry once.
If fleet-verify fails after 5 attempts, report blocked.

Output: test agent name, online status, verification results.
steps.accept_criteria: Test agent provisioned and online. Fleet-verify returns green. Agent is running the feature branch code.

steps.title: Exercise test agent with canned missions
steps.description:
Send canned test missions to the test agent to validate end-to-end behavior:

**Mission 1 — Simple Q&A:**
Send a direct question via GChat DM to the test agent. Verify it responds within 5 minutes. Check via `work-log-read` that a mission was created and completed.

**Mission 2 — Process execution:**
Send a message asking the test agent to run `p-investigate` on a stub topic. Verify the process loads and executes at least the first checkpoint. Check via `work-log-read`.

**Mission 3 — Memory round-trip:**
Send a message asking the test agent to write a test fact to Core Memory and then read it back. Verify via `work-log-read` that the fact was written and retrieved.

For each mission:
- Check `work-log-read --agent test-imp --status complete` for completion
- Check `task-log-read --agent test-imp` for any errors
- If a mission fails, fix the code, push, re-upgrade, and retry (max 3 iterations)
- If still failing after 3 iterations, report blocked with evidence

Output: mission results (pass/fail for each), evidence from work-log-read.
steps.accept_criteria: All 3 canned missions completed successfully. Evidence collected from work-log-read. Any failures were fixed and re-verified.

steps.title: Open PR and teardown test agent
steps.description:
Finalize the implementation:
1. Open a PR via GitHub API:
   - Title: 'IMP: ${branch_slug}'
   - Body: scope block, test-agent evidence (mission IDs from previous step), QA summary
   - Base branch: main
   - Head branch: refactor/IMP-${branch_slug}
2. Confirm CI passes on the PR (check via API, wait up to 10 minutes)
3. Teardown the test agent: `fleet-fire test-imp`
   - If fleet-fire fails, retry once, then force-fire — never leave a branch-ref agent standing
4. Send the `[DELEGATION-RESULT]` reply with:
   - PR URL
   - Test agent mission IDs as evidence
   - QA summary
   - Status: complete or failed

Output: PR URL, CI status, teardown confirmation, delegation result sent.
steps.accept_criteria: PR opened with scope block and test evidence. CI green. Test agent torn down. Delegation result sent to the architect agent.
